name: The Boundary Protocol
subtitle: Where you end -- and what to do about everything you've been carrying that isn't yours.
toc_note: Read it with a pen. Part I will cost you an honest hour. Part VII takes two questions a night for the rest of your life.
back_line: You are responsible to people. You are not responsible for them.
back_sub: If you're exhausted and resentful and still can't say no, you don't have a love problem. You have a property-line problem. This is how you draw the line and hold it without becoming someone you'd never want to be.
